<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def full_diff(r,c,label):
    b = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ch = [(rr,cc,b[rr][cc],a[rr][cc]) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[rr][cc]!=a[rr][cc]]
    print(label, "n=", len(ch))
    from collections import Counter
    g = Counter((rr//8,cc//8,o,n) for rr,cc,o,n in ch)
    for k,v in sorted(g.items()): print("  ",k,v)
full_diff(25,1,"click(25,1):")
full_diff(25,1,"click(25,1) again:")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def full_diff(r,c,label):
    b = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ch = [(rr,cc,b[rr][cc],a[rr][cc]) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[rr][cc]!=a[rr][cc]]
    print(label, "n=", len(ch))
    from collections import Counter
    g = Counter((rr//8,cc//8,o,n) for rr,cc,o,n in ch)
    for k,v in sorted(g.items()): print("  ",k,v)
full_diff(25,1,"click(25,1):")
full_diff(25,1,"click(25,1) again:")
</parameter>
